body: (Some are missed cases from the original PR I believe, can apply them here or over there depending on which is most appropriate)

Looks good and handles the most common case of applying changes to skin scale from the source skeleton.

The only thing I'm unsure about is if there is a workflow to retarget onto a skeleton which already has scaled bones (maybe using skin_scale to stretch the arm).... sort of a way to set "rest skin scale" of the child skeleton.

It is possible to bake skin scale into the skin and bone position, which would allow the scaled skeleton to be used as a target skeleton for retarget, but this is something you would have to code by hand.

Anyway doing both retargeting and bone scaling at the same time is a niche usecase, so I'm not sure we should add more functionality to support it. just something I was thinking about.
